source_refs.note: Book p. 205: 11.4 Values of Trigonometric Functions: the 12 identities for -theta, pi-theta, pi+theta, 2pi-theta and the list of angle measures they give (-30 to +/-360 degrees).

blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum! Ab tak hum ne trigonometric functions ki values sirf chand khaas angles par dekhi hain: \(0^{\circ}\), \(30^{\circ}\), \(45^{\circ}\), \(60^{\circ}\) aur \(90^{\circ}\). Lekin is unit mein humein in functions ke graphs (naqshe) banane hain, aur graph ke liye bohat saare points chahiye hote hain, jaise \(150^{\circ}\), \(240^{\circ}\), \(-30^{\circ}\) waghaira. To sawal yeh hai ke itne saare angles ki values kahan se layein? Jawab hai: identities (aisi barabariyan jo har angle ke liye sach hon). Is sabaq mein hum yahi seekhenge ke purani identities ki madad se kisi bhi bare ya negative angle ki value kaise nikalte hain.

Kitab kehti hai: hum \(0^{\circ}\), \(30^{\circ}\), \(45^{\circ}\), \(60^{\circ}\) aur \(90^{\circ}\) ke angles ki trigonometric values jaante hain, aur hum ne yeh identities bhi pehle saabit ki hain:

blocks.title: Teaching note

blocks.text: Kitab aage kehti hai ke in identities ko istemal kar ke hum in tamam angles ki values aasani se nikal sakte hain:

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Tareeqa hamesha teen qadam ka hai, ise achhi tarah samajh lijiye:
1. Bare angle ko \(-\theta\), \(180^{\circ} - \theta\), \(180^{\circ} + \theta\) ya \(360^{\circ} - \theta\) ki shakal mein likhiye, jahan \(\theta\) inhi basic angles mein se ho: \(0^{\circ}, 30^{\circ}, 45^{\circ}, 60^{\circ}, 90^{\circ}\).
2. Table se mutabiq identity uthaiye; is se bare angle ka function, \(\theta\) ke usi function mein badal jata hai (sign ke saath).
3. \(\theta\) ki maloom value rakh dijiye.
Yeh abhi kyun zaroori hai? Kyun ke agle sabaq (11.4.2 se 11.4.4) mein sine, cosine aur tangent ke graphs tables se banenge, jin mein \(0^{\circ}, 30^{\circ}, 60^{\circ}, \dots, 360^{\circ}\) aur negative angles ki values hongi. Un tables ki har value isi tareeqe se aati hai. Agar yeh tareeqa pakka ho gaya to graphs bilkul aasan lagenge.

blocks.caption: Values at the basic angles (our summary table, to keep beside you; decimals rounded to two places)

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Graph banate waqt humein decimals chahiye hote hain, kyun ke graph paper par \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) nahin, balke \(0.87\) naapa jata hai. Is liye yeh teen decimals zehan mein bitha lijiye: \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \approx 0.87\), \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \approx 0.71\), \(\sqrt{3} \approx 1.73\) (aur \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \approx 0.58\)).
Worked values (our practice, not printed in the book)

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh misaalein kitab mein nahin hain; yeh hum ne practice ke liye banayi hain. Har ek mein dekhiye ke pehle angle ko kis shakal mein likha, phir kaun si identity lagi.
1. \(\sin 150^{\circ}\): \(150^{\circ} = 180^{\circ} - 30^{\circ}\). Identity \(\sin(\pi - \theta) = \sin\theta\) hai, to \(\sin 150^{\circ} = \sin 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\). Tasdeeq: \(150^{\circ}\) Quadrant II mein hai, wahan sine positive hota hai; jawab bhi positive hai.
2. \(\cos 240^{\circ}\): \(240^{\circ} = 180^{\circ} + 60^{\circ}\). Identity \(\cos(\pi + \theta) = -\cos\theta\), to \(\cos 240^{\circ} = -\cos 60^{\circ} = -\frac{1}{2}\). Quadrant III mein cosine negative hota hai, is liye minus bilkul theek hai.
3. \(\cos 135^{\circ} = \cos(180^{\circ} - 45^{\circ}) = -\cos 45^{\circ} = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\).
4. \(\sin 300^{\circ} = \sin(360^{\circ} - 60^{\circ}) = -\sin 60^{\circ} = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\). Quadrant IV mein sine negative hota hai.
5. \(\tan 210^{\circ} = \tan(180^{\circ} + 30^{\circ}) = \tan 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\). Quadrant III mein tangent positive hai, is liye koi minus nahin.
6. \(\sin(-30^{\circ}) = -\sin 30^{\circ} = -\frac{1}{2}\), kyun ke \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\).
7. \(\tan(-315^{\circ})\): pehle \(\tan(-\theta) = -\tan\theta\) se \(-\tan 315^{\circ}\). Phir \(315^{\circ} = 360^{\circ} - 45^{\circ}\), aur \(\tan(2\pi - \theta) = -\tan\theta\), to \(\tan 315^{\circ} = -1\). Is liye \(\tan(-315^{\circ}) = -(-1) = 1\). Do minus mil kar plus ban gaye.
8. \(\sin(-270^{\circ}) = -\sin 270^{\circ} = -\sin(180^{\circ} + 90^{\circ}) = -(-\sin 90^{\circ}) = 1\).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Ab aap khud koshish kijiye, phir jawab dekhiye: (a) \(\cos 330^{\circ}\), (b) \(\tan 120^{\circ}\), (c) \(\cos(-60^{\circ})\).
Jawab: (a) \(\cos(360^{\circ} - 30^{\circ}) = \cos 30^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\); (b) \(\tan(180^{\circ} - 60^{\circ}) = -\tan 60^{\circ} = -\sqrt{3}\); (c) \(\cos(-60^{\circ}) = \cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\), kyun ke cosine par negative angle ka koi asar nahin hota.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Har jawab ko quadrant se zaroor check kijiye. Misaal: \(240^{\circ}\) Quadrant III mein hai, jahan cosine negative hota hai, to \(\cos 240^{\circ}\) lazmi negative aana chahiye. Agar aap ka sign quadrant se nahin milta to samajh lijiye ke identity ghalat lagi hai. Yeh das second ka check paper mein kayi marks bacha leta hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Sirf \(0^{\circ}, 30^{\circ}, 45^{\circ}, 60^{\circ}, 90^{\circ}\) ki values yaad rakhni hain; baaqi sab in se nikalti hain.
2. Table ki baara identities har listed angle ko kisi basic angle mein badal deti hain.
3. \(\pi \pm \theta\), \(2\pi - \theta\) aur \(-\theta\) mein function wahi rehta hai, sirf sign badal sakta hai.
4. Sign ka faisla angle ka quadrant karta hai.
5. Yahi values agle sabaq ke graphs ki tables bharti hain.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\cos(\pi - \theta) = \cos\theta\) likh dena. Quadrant II mein cosine negative hai, is liye sahi \(-\cos\theta\) hai. Bachne ka tareeqa: pehle quadrant likhiye, phir sign.
2. Negative angle ka bahar wala minus bhool jana: \(\tan(-315^{\circ}) = -\tan 315^{\circ}\), aur phir \(\tan 315^{\circ}\) khud bhi negative hai. Dono minus likhiye, phir simplify kijiye.
3. \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) aur \(\frac{1}{2}\) aapas mein ulat dena. Yaad rakhiye: Quadrant I mein angle barhne se sine barhta hai, is liye \(\sin 60^{\circ}\) bara (0.87) aur \(\sin 30^{\circ}\) chhota (0.5) hai.
4. Calculator degree ki bajaye radian mode mein ho to values ghalat aati hain; graph ki tables banane se pehle mode zaroor dekh lijiye.
